name: Moonshrine Sanctum
summary: Twilight's Hammer gathers beneath Queen Azshara's statue in Moonshrine Sanctum. Twilight Lord Kelris watches over the ancient shrine and the sealed way to Aku'mai's lair.

sections.title: A Desecrated Temple
sections.body: Beyond the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, Twilight's Hammer gathers in the Moonshrine Sanctum, the cult's heart inside Blackfathom Deeps. Night elves built the hall millennia ago to honor the moon and their rulers. Now the cult has defiled it, though Queen Azshara's towering statue remains carefully tended. Beneath the high stone ceiling, Twilight Lord Kelris watches as cultists chant dark rituals day and night.

sections.title: The Threshold to Aku'mai
sections.body: Heavy double stone doors seal Aku'mai's Lair behind ancient wards. Four ritual braziers stand around Azshara's statue, and lighting them breaks the seal. Their flames also rouse the shrine's guardians: giant crabs, snapped-jaw turtles, armored makrura, and conjured water elementals, all bound to defend the sanctum from intruders.

faq.answer: Moonshrine Sanctum lies deep inside Blackfathom Deeps, along the Zoram Strand in Ashenvale. Beyond the flooded Moonshrine Ruins, it stands just before the lair of Aku'mai the hydra.

faq.q: Who rules over the Moonshrine Sanctum?
faq.answer: Twilight Lord Kelris commands the sanctum. A formidable sorcerer who weaves sleep, he leads Twilight's Hammer rituals for its ancient patron, touched by the void.

faq.q: Why is there an intact statue of Azshara here?
faq.answer: Night elves built the sanctum before the Great Sundering as an ancient temple dedicated to Queen Azshara. Twilight's Hammer keeps her statue in good condition and seems to have no quarrel with the queen it honors.

faq.q: How do you open the large doors at the back of the chamber?
faq.answer: Light the four ritual candles around the feet of Azshara's statue to open the doors to Aku'mai's Lair. Each flame awakens waves of guardian aquatic beasts and water elementals that must be subdued.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see an ancient temple your ancestors carved before the Sundering, now turned into a sacrificial hollow for Twilight's Hammer and naga. Even here, Ashenvale's shadows reach.
As a priest, you hear Twilight Lord Kelris twist sacred devotion into maddening whispers of the void, far from restorative divine prayer.
